name: 78245 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78245 (San Antonio) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78245 (San Antonio) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78245 (San Antonio) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
